How the odds work

Each team starts from a projected win total and is updated with every result (the projection counts like 30 games, so early records move it but don't take over). We then simulate the rest of the 82-game season 20,000 times, with some uncertainty in every team's strength, and count how often each team finishes top six and top ten in its conference. This is model v0: it uses records only, not injuries, schedule strength or point differential.
